behavior: Positive helper acknowledgement is tracked before local result validation and durable witness completion. Any subsequent local not_sent or generic error becomes unknown; the reserved witness remains and runtime is marked uncertain.
Existing unknown error details remain unchanged; actual helper not_sent before positive acknowledgement still releases the reservation.
Malformed mkdir and worktree-binding results retain proof, and subsequent attempts never call the helper again.

tests.initialFailure: The first new worktree fixture lacked worktreeId and reached the existing unknown identity guard before malformed binding validation. The fixture was corrected to carry the actual operationId; no production behavior was weakened.
tests.notRun: An initial target command named absent worktree.test.ts and the runner rejected it before running tests; corrected to worktree-witness.test.ts.
